source.title: 2020 Census Redistricting Data (P.L. 94-171), Table P4
source.table: P4: Hispanic or Latino, and not Hispanic or Latino by race for the population 18 years and over
limitations: The denominator is the 2020 population age 18 and over, not citizen voting-age population or a 2024 eligible-voter estimate.
The demographic vintage predates the 2024 election baseline by four years.
PL 94-171 tabulations use the 2020 Census disclosure-avoidance system.
Candidate preference is not observed in Census data and must not be inferred from these aggregate counts alone.
